summary: This Docker Compose configuration defines two services: a Joomla web application and a MySQL database. The Joomla service won't start until the database service is healthy, which is verified by having the database repeatedly check that it's responding to MySQL ping commands.

explanations.6: depends_on tells Docker that the joomla service needs joomladb to exist before it starts.
explanations.10: condition: service_healthy means don't just wait for the database container to start—wait until it reports it's actually healthy and ready to accept connections.
explanations.16: healthcheck is a set of instructions Docker runs to periodically verify the service is working correctly.
explanations.18: This test runs the mysqladmin ping command to check if the MySQL database is responding; if it responds, the service is considered healthy.
explanations.20: timeout: 20s means if the ping command takes longer than 20 seconds to respond, consider that check failed.
explanations.22: retries: 10 means Docker will try the health check up to 10 times before giving up and marking the service as unhealthy.
